title: A deployer address of a kind the account column cannot store is recorded
severity_basis: A deployer address of a non-account kind reached an account column. Fixed upstream by PR #745 (ce0820d7); the linter fires at the pre-fix commit and is silent after (make lint-before-after).

entries.observed: XDR102: xdr.ScAddress.String() renders M…, W…, B… and L… strkeys for the muxed, claimable-balance and pool kinds; it reaches participant sink processors.StateChangeBuilder.WithCreator at line 73 without being reduced to the base account (ToAccountId) or kind-checked
